# Step - skip

`skip` · category: [Filters](../../traversal/step_reference.md#filters)

Skips the first n traversers (Scope.local: elements of each collection).

## Forms

```text
skip(arg1: i64)
skip(arg1: Scope, arg2: i64)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v().values("name").skip(4).to_list()   // ["ripple", "peter"]
```
